API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops Remove User
Groups Ops Remove User
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups/:id/users/:userId

Removes a specific user from an existing group using the group ID and the user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the group from which the user needs to be removed.

userId
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the user to be removed from the group.

Responses
​
204
400
401

The user has been removed from the group.

No content is returned in the response, but headers may be useful for validation purposes.
